scenes.narration: Volcanoes form at tectonic plate boundaries, where hot magma from Earth's interior rises toward the surface.
scenes.prompt: Cross-section of Earth showing moving tectonic plates with a glowing magma chamber beneath, realistic style suitable for Stable Diffusion 1.5
scenes.motion_direction: slow zoom in on the plate boundary

scenes.narration: Molten rock called magma contains dissolved gases. As it rises, pressure builds until...
scenes.prompt: Close-up of bubbling molten rock with gas bubbles rising upward, warm colors and dramatic lighting
scenes.motion_direction: pan down to reveal a vent opening

scenes.narration: When the pressure is high enough, an explosive eruption blasts ash and rock into the sky. In quieter eruptions, lava flows gently across land.
scenes.prompt: Split view: left side shows a plume of ash erupting from a volcano; right side shows a river of lava flowing down a slope, realistic style
scenes.motion_direction: pan from the explosive plume to the lava flow

scenes.narration: Over time, cooled lava hardens into rock, building mountains like Mount St. Helens.
scenes.prompt: A mountain peak with hardened layers of lava against a sunrise sky, cinematic composition
scenes.motion_direction: slow zoom out to reveal the full landscape
